versions.content: Non-Volatile RAM Manager (NvM) The NvM provides synchronous and asynchronous services for management and storage of non-volatile data across EEPROM and Flash hardware. function NvM_WriteBlock [SWS_CP_MEM_00001] Std_ReturnType NvM_WriteBlock(NvM_BlockIdType BlockId, const void* NvM_SrcPtr); Queues an asynchronous write request for the specified NVRAM block. Copies data to RAM mirror and enqueues job for underlying MemIf driver. function NvM_ReadBlock [SWS_CP_MEM_00005] Std_ReturnType NvM_ReadBlock(NvM_BlockIdType BlockId, void* NvM_DstPtr); Queues an asynchronous read request for the specified NVRAM block, reading hardware data into RAM mirror with CRC validation. function NvM_ReadAll [SWS_CP_MEM_00003] void NvM_ReadAll(void); Global startup multi-block request invoked during EcuM startup to load all configured persistent blocks into their RAM mirrors. function NvM_WriteAll [SWS_CP_MEM_00004] void NvM_WriteAll(void); Global shutdown multi-block request writing all modified persistent blocks from RAM mirrors back to NV memory before power down. function NvM_GetErrorStatus [SWS_CP_MEM_00006] Std_ReturnType NvM_GetErrorStatus(NvM_BlockIdType BlockId, NvM_RequestResultType* RequestResultPtr); Queries the result of the last asynchronous single-block or multi-block operation (NVM_REQ_OK, NVM_REQ_NOT_OK, NVM_REQ_PENDING, NVM_REQ_INTEGRITY_FAILED). Memory Abstraction Interface (MemIf) MemIf abstracts multiple memory hardware drivers (Flash EEPROM Emulation Fee and EEPROM Driver Ea) into a uniform linear 32-bit address space. function MemIf_Read [SWS_CP_MEM_00010] Std_ReturnType MemIf_Read(uint8 DeviceIndex, uint16 BlockNumber, uint16 BlockOffset, uint8* DataBufferPtr, uint16 Length); Invokes the driver read routine for the selected memory abstraction device.
